features.name: Suggest Number Series with Copilot
features.description: Copilot capability that generates, modifies or maintains number series for Business Central. Can create series for specific records, modules or entire companies with customizable prompts.
caveats: AI generated content might be incorrect
Manual deletion of incorrect suggestions may be required

features.name: Number Series Year Number Inclusion
features.description: Copilot can generate number series that include year numbers (e.g., last two digits of fiscal year like 24 for 2024) when explicitly requested in the prompt.
caveats: Requires explicit instruction in the prompt

features.name: Automatic Number Series Update
features.description: When suggesting number series, Copilot automatically updates the number series configuration in related setup pages such as service management setup.

features.name: Number Series Year Preparation
features.description: Copilot can prepare existing number series for the next year by creating new date-based series lines with appropriate starting dates.
caveats: May generate suggestions for unrelated series if prompt is not specific enough

features.name: Prompt Guides for Number Series
features.description: Copilot number series dialog includes prompt guides that provide templates for common tasks such as creating series for new companies, setting up for the next year, and modifying existing series.

features.name: Complete Company Number Series Generation
features.description: Copilot can generate complete number series configurations for all modules in a new company based on the company's user experience setting (e.g., premium level).
caveats: Scope depends on company user experience setting
